faqs.question: Is this the same machine as Type 311 or Type 511?
faqs.answer: No. Type 311 lists 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 15 m / 5 m, particle ≤2 mm. Type 511 lists 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 30 m / 15 m, particle ≤6 mm. This plunger row lists 9/11 kW, 4 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m / 40 m, particle ≤8 mm.

faqs.question: Is it a trailer concrete pump?
faqs.answer: No. It is a mortar spraying machine. Trailer pumps sit on the electric, diesel and mixer-pump hubs.
